name: Capacitor Production Line Solution
summary: A complete line automation solution for capacitor manufacturers, covering winding, assembly, liquid injection, aging, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The capacitor production line solution is a complete automated line solution provided by TXAM for electronic component manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The entire line covers the full process including metallized film winding, core assembly, liquid injection, welding, aging testing, and final inspection and packaging.

Solution Advantages

  • High-speed winding to increase production capacity
  • Automated liquid injection to ensure sealing
  • Aging testing to ensure product reliability
  • Full-process automation
  • Turnkey engineering service

Service Content

Provides full-process support including line planning, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning, and after-sales service.
